decision_points.condition: 5GMM cause is #78 (PLMN not allowed to operate at the present UE location)

decision_points.condition: 5GMM cause is #79 (UAS services not allowed)

decision_points.condition: 5GMM cause is #80 (Disaster roaming for the determined PLMN with disaster condition not allowed)

If counter = 5, delete context, start T3502 (if > 0), set status 5U2, enter 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION or .PLMN-SEARCH.

decision_points.condition: Change in current TAI before registration completion

outcomes.outcome: Abort and re-initiate initial registration.

decision_points.condition: Tracking area border crossed after ACCEPT but before COMPLETE sent AND new TAI not in TAI list

outcomes.outcome: Abort initial registration, initiate mobility registration update.

decision_points.condition: Transmission failure of REGISTRATION COMPLETE indication with change in current TAI AND new TAI not in TAI list

outcomes.outcome: Abort initial registration, initiate mobility registration update.

decision_points.condition: Transmission failure of REGISTRATION COMPLETE indication with change in current TAI AND new TAI is in TAI list

outcomes.outcome: Resend REGISTRATION COMPLETE.

decision_points.condition: Transmission failure of REGISTRATION REQUEST indication from lower layers

outcomes.outcome: Abort and re-initiate initial registration.

decision_points.condition: Lower layer failure before REGISTRATION COMPLETE received (T3550 running)

outcomes.outcome: Abort procedure, enter 5GMM-REGISTERED. Consider old and new GUTI valid.

decision_points.condition: REGISTRATION REQUEST received with protocol error

outcomes.outcome: Return REGISTRATION REJECT with cause #96, #99, #100, or #111.

decision_points.condition: T3550 time-out (first 4 expiries)

outcomes.outcome: Retransmit REGISTRATION ACCEPT, reset and restart T3550.

decision_points.condition: T3550 time-out (fifth expiry)

outcomes.outcome: Abort procedure, enter 5GMM-REGISTERED. Consider old and new GUTI valid.

decision_points.condition: New REGISTRATION REQUEST received after ACCEPT sent, before COMPLETE received (if expected), AND IEs differ

outcomes.outcome: Abort previous procedure, progress new registration procedure.

decision_points.condition: New REGISTRATION REQUEST received after ACCEPT sent, before COMPLETE received (if expected), AND IEs do not differ

outcomes.outcome: Resend REGISTRATION ACCEPT, restart T3550 (no retransmission counter increment).

decision_points.condition: REGISTRATION REQUEST received in state 5GMM-REGISTERED

outcomes.outcome: May initiate common procedures. If UE genuine, delete old context and progress new request. If not genuine, maintain old context.
outcomes.next_step: Common procedures / Process new REGISTRATION REQUEST / Maintain old context

decision_points.condition: Mobility/Periodic Registration Update received before REGISTRATION COMPLETE (if expected)

outcomes.outcome: Stop T3550, consider allocated GUTI valid, progress mobility/periodic registration update.

decision_points.condition: DEREGISTRATION REQUEST received before REGISTRATION COMPLETE (if expected)

outcomes.outcome: Abort initial registration, progress de-registration.

decision_points.condition: REGISTRATION REQUEST received with invalid/unacceptable UE security capabilities

outcomes.outcome: Return REGISTRATION REJECT.

depends_on: UE receives REGISTRATION ACCEPT containing specific IEs requiring acknowledgement
dependencies.reason: REGISTRATION COMPLETE is only sent if specific IEs requiring acknowledgement are received in REGISTRATION ACCEPT (e.g., Network slicing info update, CAG info update, SOR container, T3550 started by AMF).
Timer T3550 is stopped upon reception of the REGISTRATION COMPLETE message.
The specific actions taken by the UE depend entirely on receiving the REGISTRATION REJECT message and its 5GMM cause value.

dependencies.step: UE initiates retry after T3511 expiry
depends_on: T3510 timeout OR REGISTRATION REJECT (other/abnormal cause) OR Lower layer failure
dependencies.reason: Timer T3511 is started as part of the retry mechanism when the registration attempt counter is less than 5 following specific failure conditions.

dependencies.step: UE initiates retry after T3346 expiry
depends_on: UE receives REGISTRATION REJECT with cause #22 (Congestion)
dependencies.reason: Timer T3346 is started upon receiving cause #22, and the procedure is retried upon its expiry.
Retransmission of REGISTRATION ACCEPT is triggered by the expiry of timer T3550.

dependencies.step: UE includes entire REGISTRATION REQUEST in NAS message container of SECURITY MODE COMPLETE
depends_on: UE does not have a valid 5G NAS security context when sending initial REGISTRATION REQUEST
dependencies.reason: This step is conditional on the UE lacking a security context during the initial request transmission.
